entities.summary: Joana Choumali is a freelance photographer based in Abidjan, Côte d'Ivoire. She uses photography to explore issues of identity and the diversity of African cultures. Joana Choumali was a painters & sculptors from Abidjan (b. 1974, Abidjan). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
